name: KingbaseES
tagline: Chinese PostgreSQL-derived RDBMS with Oracle, MySQL and SQL Server compatibility modes.
description: KingbaseES is a commercial relational database from CETC Kingbase (formerly Beijing Kingbase, which grew out of Renmin University of China). Its modern versions are built on PostgreSQL code and add compatibility modes for Oracle, MySQL and SQL Server syntax, plus its own clustering options (read-write separation clusters, shared-storage RAC and sharding). It is one of the main beneficiaries of China's domestic-software programmes in government, energy and finance, and the V9 line is actively developed. Outside the Chinese market it is rarely seen, and most documentation is in Chinese.

pricing.notes: Commercial licences sold mainly into Chinese government and enterprise projects.

scale.notes: Primary/standby clusters, a shared-storage cluster option and a sharding edition.

strengths: One engine with Oracle, MySQL, SQL Server and PostgreSQL compatibility modes
PostgreSQL heritage gives mature MVCC and SQL features
Certified for Chinese government and domestic hardware/OS stacks (Kunpeng, Loongson, Kylin)
Shared-storage and sharding options for HA and scale
weaknesses: Documentation, support and community are almost entirely Chinese
Compatibility modes are not complete clones; migrations still need testing
Little presence on global cloud platforms
useCases: Replacing Oracle in Chinese government systems
Applications that must run on domestic Chinese hardware and OS
notIdealFor: Teams wanting community PostgreSQL extensions unchanged
